published_prior_art.cite: AliRichardsonSpirtes2009 characterizes single-MAG equivalence, not synchronized common-basal regime-family replacement.
DaiEtAl2025SelectionIntervention gives endpoint semantics but not the reverse common-basal witness/frontier over a compatibility fiber.
DaiEtAl2025SelectionIntervention Lemma 4 already yields clause (i); clause (ii) may remain a useful new certificate.
DaiEtAl2025SelectionIntervention explicitly leaves CDIS completeness and an equivalence-class representation open; JaberEtAl2020PsiFCI has no pre-treatment selection.

DaiEtAl2025SelectionIntervention conjectures completeness; ZhouKocaoglu2026TowardsCompleteness concerns known-target soft interventions and uses enumeration rather than this selected common-basal local calculus.
WangDuZhou2025PolynomialDelay establishes polynomial-delay MAG listing with supplied singleton background knowledge; this is only closure accounting conditional on the proposed calculus.
ColomboEtAl2012RFCI gives asymptotic FCI/RFCI consistency and KimNeykovBalakrishnanWasserman2024 supplies query-level discrete-CI testing, but neither gives this graph-level result.
Zhang2008FCICompleteness supplies completeness over the unrestricted MAG fiber; the stated restricted-fiber comparison is a direct definitional corollary rather than a separate prior result.

novelty_flags.label: lem:visible-selectedness-certificates, clause (i)
novelty_flags.one_line: The assertion that an adjacency absent observationally but present in an intervention MAG certifies both endpoints as ancestrally selected is already the immediate forward consequence of Dai et al.'s Lemma 4.

soundness_flags.label: def:basal-replacement and lem:replacement-preservation
soundness_flags.one_line: The replacement specifies only graph and target-set edits, not replacement structural kernels or a joint law, so eta^{A(eta),B}, its pooled selected laws, and the claimed faithfulness/preservation are not yet defined as model objects.

soundness_flags.label: thm:observational-fiber-refinement
soundness_flags.one_line: The fiber inclusion and the endpoint-richness iff merely unfold the two endpoint-invariance definitions after the image-fiber inclusion; no independent characterization of endpoint richness is supplied.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Lemma 4 says an intervention-regime adjacency absent from the observational MAG can occur only through a path whose endpoints and internal vertices are ancestrally selected.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6–8, Lemma 5, Theorem 2, Theorem 3 and completeness discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives the indicator-neighbor direct-or-indirect-selected characterization, equality of regime-MAG adjacencies and v-structures for equivalence, proves CDIS soundness, and states that completeness and an equivalence-class representation remain open.
Psi-FCI is proved complete for its unknown-target interventional equivalence class by constructing compatible augmented-graph representatives; the paper does not model pre-treatment selection.

The paper presents polynomial-delay MAG listing by recursively introducing singleton background knowledge, with sound locally complete rules, and notes incompleteness for general background knowledge.
Zhang adds orientation rules making FCI complete for uniquely determined causal structure under the standard ancestral-graph assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make basal replacement a genuine model construction: give replacement basal and intervention kernels, prove their common selected joint law realizes every preserved full-regime MAG signature, or recast the witness claim existentially over fully specified replacement models.

Remove or explicitly cite the Dai-Lemma-4 restatement in visible-selectedness-certificates clause (i), then isolate clause (ii) as a strict new certificate with a smallest nontrivial signature example that Dai's result does not supply.

Replace the observational-fiber refinement tautology with a substantive graph-theoretic sufficient-and-necessary characterization of endpoint richness for a nontrivial selected-DAG subclass, or demote it to a boundary corollary.

recommended_next_step: Revise the replacement definition and remove the two non-kernel overclaims, then continue to Stage 0 on the fixed finite common-basal calculus.
